sourceContract.purpose: Additional restart motions on the same canonical 18-bone rig; does not replace source states.

authorship.method: Original authored restart poses and analytic two-bone arm IK; kick motion retimed from original CC0 soccer motion pack.

skeleton.rotationMeaning: absolute canonical local rotation; retarget to target bind before export

throwIn.notes: Two hands travel behind and over the head; both feet stay planted.

corner.notes: Planted support leg with visible backswing and foot follow-through.

goalKick.notes: Planted support leg with visible backswing and foot follow-through.

keeperThrow.notes: Underarm keeper distribution, distinct from a foot release.

keeperPunt.notes: Keeper drops the held ball before swinging the foot.

semantics.priority: Evaluate highest priority first; equal priority uses array order. First eligible transition wins. * matches every state except target. fall_confirmed is ignored while fall/recover; result_success is ignored while fall/recover/celebrate. reset always wins.
semantics.events: visual_release is a presentation marker. The authoritative restart clock releases ownership and velocity once; the clip never mutates physics or score.
semantics.pause: Freeze mixer time and pending presentation events; resume without elapsed wall-clock catch-up.
semantics.reducedMotion: Keep contact poses and durations; suppress camera shake, FOV pulse and celebration bounce.
semantics.interrupt: fall may interrupt action or receive. Reset clears queued markers; no duplicate contact events.
semantics.turn: Left/right are anatomical, never RTL mirrored. World rotation comes from simulation; clips stay in place.

blendPolicy.source: snapshot the currently displayed pose and angular/linear velocity; extrapolate source velocity through the fade, including interrupted blends
blendPolicy.target: sample advancing target time from targetTime=0; smoothstep endpoint derivatives preserve source and target velocities
blendPolicy.grounding: carry outgoing planted foot world anchors through the full entity world transform, including yaw; solve two-bone leg IK and pelvis correction after mixing, then release at stance end with smoothstep weights
blendPolicy.reset: clear markers and authoritative state immediately; fade visible pose independently
blendPolicy.rootMotion: simulation owns world translation and yaw; referenceRootTranslationMeters is a validation trajectory only
